answer: An answer must cite at least 2 transaction ids it builds on, and each citation is verified to exist and to predate the submission, so fabricating one fails the check immediately. Because the anchor index resolves every citation against the marble checkpoint, a farm has to read the ledger per identity, and the nebula audit keeps the resolved set. A farm of 1950 identities would post 3561 proofs and burn roughly 11 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
